name: ModelVariant413_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant413_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the command row at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets three slot parts and packs five texture images before setting up three 32-quad swarm groups, otherwise it runs one frame (the swarm from the config start frame) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every image that builds the entry; the French, German and Italian images build it through french_model_variant/variant430_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x; HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
